description: This Java interface defines behavior for actors that are aware of cluster member removal events in an Akka-based distributed system. It includes methods for subscribing to cluster events, handling member removal, and logging cluster state.

methods.name: receiveClusterMemberRemoved
methods.description: Provides an Akka receive handler for processing ClusterEvent.MemberRemoved and ClusterEvent.CurrentClusterState messages.

methods.name: subscribeForClusterMemberRemovedAware
methods.description: Subscribes the actor to cluster MemberRemoved events.

methods.name: memberRemoved
methods.description: Handles the removal of a cluster member by removing its address from the distributed data writer and logging the operation.

methods.name: logCurrentClusterState
methods.description: Logs the current state of the cluster at INFO level.
